note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Both scenes run the same supplied, editable route in the configured order ('Sequence as configured (illustrative)'); only the supplied state differs, on one leg: documented (solid outline, ●) or questioned in this configured example (dashed outline — the disputed marker — ◆). Nothing states a valid method, a deadline, 'deemed' service, a winner or any effect. Coordinator standing rule (AUTHORING item 20): long-labels-stress is capped by the subject floor (each scene >= 0.20 of the frame height, causation-05 decision). True driver, measured on the layout: with every field at near-maximum length (three shared facts of 77 characters, a 96-character changed fact) the shared strip leaves the scenes a band of 0.091 of the frame height at 1:1 (rendered figures 69.6 px, text 17.1 px) and 0.102 at 9:16. Tried: three facts with a 59-character changed fact gives 0.217 at 1:1 but 0.106 at 9:16; two facts with 59 gives 0.095 / 0.106. Cap kept: one shared fact (77 characters, near-maximum) and a 59-character changed fact: scenes 0.274 (1:1) and 0.201 (9:16). Every other field stays at near-maximum length.
